text:
elaine (pm): quick sync — posted a short 'routing governance' draft. need to align on pilot selection and must-have launch gates by Fri. https://redwood.share/routing-governance-draft 

samir (arch): reading. main ask: split policies into 'placement' (where traffic lands) and 'fallback' (what happens when placement can't satisfy). that'll simplify rollouts.

miguel (eng): agree. operationally we also need defaults for min_reserve and soft_eviction_time; otherwise we'll default to expensive reserves. product to pick defaults for pilots?

nina (sre): ops checklist (short): canary 5%, stability 20m, p95 latency <= 1.8x baseline, fallback alerts if triggered > 2/min. also need synthetic checks to assert region actually served.

zoe (cs): CS input: two customers want per-route residency and an audit of routing decisions. They expect a plain-language policy summary for contracts.

harry (legal): we'll need that summary + a SL doc that states fallback behavior and custody of logs. also retention period for audit events.

samir (arch): sample DSL sketch for product/legal to read: 
```
policy payments_eu {
  match: customer=="Acme" && route=="payments"
  placement: [eu-west-1]
  fallback: {allowed: true, priority: [eu-central-1, global], model_variant: "compact"}
  isolation: hard
}
```

miguel (eng): tech caveat: 'isolation: hard' implies node labeling and reserved capacity or host pools. will spike bin-packing. I'll produce a delta estimate if product selects pilots.

elaine (pm): proposed launch gates (draft): 1) 99.5% regional success over 24h canary, 2) cost delta acknowledged and within pilot cap, 3) KMS key in-region when isolation required, 4) customer comms + legal signoff on residency. objections?

zoe (cs): +1. add a customer comms template that calls out which routes are in-scope and expected failover behavior.

nina (sre): I'll draft a minimal runbook and synthetic probe plan. also we should log policy_hit and fallback_reason as minimal audit events.

samir (arch): telemetry dependency noted. Console needs a policy dashboard showing hits, fallbacks, and econ impact per policy.

miguel (eng): action: I'll run sizing for 3 candidate pilots (Acme, FinCo, BetaLabs) and show GPU footprint + token cost delta. ETA Tue.

elaine (pm): action items: 1) Product add pilot rows to matrix by Mon EOD. 2) Eng sizing (miguel) Tue. 3) SRE runbook (nina) Tue. 4) Legal/CS summary template (harry/zoe) Tue. We'll pick pilots Wed and lock minimal scope for Q3.

deploy-bot: infra/policy-dsl v0.1 pushed to staging (triggered by samir).

samir (arch): last note: include a 'soft_fallback_to_model_variant' flag so we can degrade model to preserve regional guarantees.
